title: Simulating surveys from catalogs to cosmology with Euclid, SPT, and UNIONS
author: Cail Daley
description: Mocks and forward models from catalogs to cosmology, through a Euclid × SPT-3G 6×2pt analysis and a new UNIONS shape catalog.

sections.title: Simulating surveys
sections.outline: An overview of the three parts and what unites them; mocks that reproduce a survey to validate pipelines and characterize systematics; simulations from cheap to realistic, with forward models for explicit and implicit inference at the realistic end.

sections.title: Euclid × SPT-3G
sections.outline: Euclid shear and clustering crossed with SPT-3G CMB lensing: the overlap, the pipeline and its mocks, the blinded TR1 data vector, blinded posteriors against ACT DR6, and where SPT-3G is tighter.

sections.title: UNIONS
sections.outline: The first UNIONS cosmic-shear release over 3,500 deg², the new 191-million-galaxy shape catalog over 5,200 deg², its PSF-leakage check on injected realizations, and the tomographic cosmic shear and 3×2pt with SPHEREx it feeds.

sections.title: Doing science now
sections.outline: How the two analyses were done and what comes next: simulations as a verifiable environment for agents, the pipeline, simulations and data held against each other, a forward model of the CMB-lensing reconstruction and simulation-based inference as the work proposed for ICE, Lightcone, the questions this puts to the community, and a summary.

sections.title: Backup
sections.outline: The blinding rehearsal on a mock, the lens ratio as a check on shear calibration, the systematics-template crosses and the FLASK covariance; the UNIONS first-release S8, B-modes, mock comparison and blinding, the v2 error bars, robustness tests, contours and the IA prior; the earlier opening and close on how collaborations work.
